name: Atombit
blog_profile: Atombit operates through specialized sub-brands (Profusion for data analytics, Amplify Analytix for customer intelligence) targeting financial services with AI/ML-powered customer data platforms. Their methodology centers on predictive analytics, next-best-action decisioning, and real-time customer segmentation for banking and insurance. Delivery model combines proprietary data science platforms with consulting services, positioning as an AI-native CX intelligence partner rather than a traditional survey-based XM firm. Thought leadership themes emphasize GenAI applications in customer lifetime value optimization and hyper-personalization at scale.

name: Sovanta
blog_profile: Sovanta differentiates through deep SAP-Qualtrics integration, building embedded experience analytics directly into SAP workflows via SAP BTP. Their methodology bridges operational data (O-data) with experience data (X-data) at the process level, targeting SAP-centric enterprises in DACH markets. Delivery model focuses on custom SAP Fiori-based experience dashboards and AI agent orchestration within existing SAP environments. Thought leadership emphasizes the convergence of ERP operational intelligence with real-time customer and employee experience signals.

name: New Metrics
blog_profile: New Metrics is the dominant Qualtrics implementation partner in the GCC region, specializing in citizen experience and government digital transformation programs. Their methodology combines Qualtrics platform deployment with Arabic-language CX program design tailored to Gulf public sector requirements. Delivery model is deeply embedded in Saudi Vision 2030 and UAE government excellence frameworks, providing end-to-end XM program management. Thought leadership centers on national-scale experience measurement, government service benchmarking, and cultural adaptation of global CX best practices for Middle Eastern markets.

name: Ipsos CX
blog_profile: Ipsos CX leverages the global research giant's scale to deliver enterprise CX measurement, benchmarking, and ROI quantification programs. Their methodology is research-centric, combining survey-based VoC with behavioral analytics and competitive benchmarking across industries. As a Medallia implementation partner, they bridge traditional market research with modern XM platform deployment. Thought leadership focuses on loyalty economics, experience ROI attribution, and cross-industry consumer expectation benchmarks, positioning as the research-validated alternative to pure technology-led CX consulting.

name: commonFont
blog_profile: commonFont is a US-based Qualtrics-focused consultancy specializing in financial services CX program design and platform optimization. Their methodology emphasizes enterprise-scale Qualtrics deployments with strong technical implementation capabilities, including AI agent configuration and experience orchestration workflows. Delivery model combines strategic CX advisory with hands-on Qualtrics platform engineering, targeting banking, insurance, and healthcare verticals. Thought leadership consistently addresses Qualtrics product updates, AI-powered analytics best practices, and practical enterprise XM program optimization.

name: Higher Oak
blog_profile: Higher Oak is a UK/EU-based Qualtrics partner offering XM program consulting and implementation services. Their historical content has focused on practical Qualtrics platform guidance, CX program design, and employee experience measurement. The extended content absence makes it difficult to assess current strategic positioning or AI adoption stance. Delivery model appears centered on mid-market Qualtrics implementations across UK and European markets.

name: Lukkap
blog_profile: Lukkap is a Spanish CX and EX consultancy operating across Spain and Latin America with a platform-agnostic, methodology-driven approach to experience transformation. Their content emphasizes customer journey mapping, employee experience design, and organizational change management as interconnected disciplines. Delivery model is consulting-led without strong technology platform allegiance, positioning as strategic advisors rather than implementation partners. Thought leadership themes include workforce transformation, customer journey redesign, and experience-driven business model innovation in Spanish-speaking markets.

name: Izo
blog_profile: Izo is an Iberoamerican CX consultancy with Qualtrics-certified operations spanning 15+ Spanish-speaking markets, positioning as the regional leader in enterprise Voice of Customer program design. Their methodology combines CX strategy consulting with Qualtrics platform implementation, emphasizing customer journey analytics and digital experience optimization. Delivery model leverages pan-regional presence to serve multinational enterprises across Latin America and Spain. Thought leadership focuses on CX maturity frameworks, VoC program design, and customer-centric digital transformation in Spanish-speaking enterprise contexts.

name: Globant
blog_profile: Globant is a global digital transformation company whose Connected Experiences Studio addresses CX within a broader AI-engineering and digital product development framework. Their methodology positions experience design as inseparable from AI-native engineering, embedding CX within large-scale technology transformation engagements. Delivery model leverages 25,000+ technologists for end-to-end digital experience builds rather than advisory-only CX consulting. Thought leadership overwhelmingly emphasizes generative AI enterprise adoption, AI agent development, and AI-augmented experience engineering, with standalone CX thought leadership relatively subordinated to the AI-first corporate narrative.

name: GemSeek
blog_profile: GemSeek fue absorbida por Accenture Song. Su propuesta original era analytics de CX con foco en predicción de churn y modelado de lealtad — un enfoque data science-first dentro del espacio CX. Sin actividad independiente desde la adquisición.

name: Acceleration Strategy
blog_profile: Acceleration Strategy is a Canada/US-based Qualtrics partner maintaining the highest sustained content cadence among monitored competitors, with deep focus on Qualtrics AI product analysis and enterprise XM program optimization. Their methodology emphasizes Qualtrics-native AI agent deployment, experience orchestration workflows, and data-driven program maturity advancement. Delivery model combines strategic CX advisory with hands-on Qualtrics technical implementation across North American enterprise accounts. Thought leadership consistently tracks and analyzes new Qualtrics platform capabilities, positioning them as a go-to knowledge source for Qualtrics ecosystem buyers.
